newsitem.title: USA: J. Ray McDermott names Bobby Rawle president.
newsitem.headline: J. Ray McDermott names Bobby Rawle president.

text.p: J. Ray McDermott said on Monday its board has elected Bobby Rawle as president and chief operating officer.
Rawle was formerly vice president and group executive for the company's north, central and south America operations, the company said.
Rawle, 48, joined the company in 1971 and and has worked for operations in Southeast Asia, the North Sea, the Middle East and the U.S.
The company is a worldwide marine construction company for the offshore oil and gas industry.
McDermott International Inc holds a majority stake in the company.
